summary: A Quote subscription on an NSE equity: the 102-byte detailed packet becomes a Quote frame with every quote field.

notes: The web's detailed frame sends no change, bid/ask or 52-week fields though the packet carries them (pocketful_adapter.py:581-598); the desktop does not send them either.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

Pocketful sends the last trade time in epoch seconds; the web passes the seconds on as ltt (1762656900), the desktop sends epoch milliseconds (1762656900000), the unit the docs give every WebSocket time.
The desktop sends the canonical last_quantity for every broker and Pocketful's web name last_trade_quantity beside it with the same value; this web adapter sends last_trade_quantity only.
The detailed packet carries the open interest and the web's Quote frame sends it (0 for an equity); the desktop's Quote frame leaves OI out, which the carrier work is to fix.
